description: Local fixtures: registration and mailbox, file upload, member portal, canvas page.
notes: Local test pages. /register: an email field, two password fields and Register; the confirmation mail arrives in Mailbox, where its link confirms the account. /upload: a file input, then the Upload button once; the next page shows the resulting link. /portal: a login form (username, password), then an inbox listing messages; unread ones are new. A canvas page draws its controls as pixels: use the picture.

pages.name: portal-login
pages.text_marker: Sign in to your member portal

procedures.description: Log in to the member portal with the secrets portal_user and portal_password.

steps.goal: Type portal_user into the textbox named Username.
Type portal_password into the textbox named Password and click Sign in.
